dossier:
The family is designed for local installation on consumer hardware, supporting asynchronous weight streaming to manage VRAM usage [MODEL.md].    If the task is Text-to-Image and commercial use is required, then use FLUX.1 [schnell] (License: apache-2.0) [MODEL.md].
   If the task is Text-to-Image and non-commercial use is acceptable, then use FLUX.1 [dev] or FLUX.1 [schnell] [MODEL.md].
   If the task is Image Editing (in-context generation/editing), then use FLUX.1 Kontext [dev] [MODEL.md].
   If the task is In/Out-painting, then use FLUX.1 Fill [dev] [MODEL.md].
   If the task is Structural Conditioning using Canny edges, then use FLUX.1 Canny [dev] or FLUX.1 Canny [dev] LoRA [MODEL.md].
